items.title: Autumn Demand Lull Deepens Spot Natural Gas Sell-Off
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices tumbled Friday, with some of the steepest losses concentrated in the Southeast and Appalachia, where recovering production and sluggish autumn demand left physical markets struggling to find support ahead of the weekend.

items.title: Winter’s No-Show Puts Natural Gas Bulls on Ice
items.summary: November natural gas futures capped a punishing week Friday, extending their sell-off as warmer weather forecasts pointed to sluggish heating demand and a potentially growing supply cushion that could keep prices under pressure into winter.

items.title: Woodfibre LNG Construction Advances as AECO Curve Signals Soft 2027 Market
items.summary: Woodfibre LNG has moved up the completion target for its British Columbia (BC) export facility by several months after disclosing construction progress has reached the 75% mark.

items.title: Natural Gas Price Pressure Back in Full Force
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures floundered at midday on Friday as traders gave more weight to weak near-term weather demand than solid LNG activity.

items.summary: US natural gas exports to Mexico are dipping heading into winter, even as new LNG projects and other demand drivers appear on the horizon.

items.title: Warm Forecasts Overwhelm Bullish Outlook, Push Winter Natural Gas Prices Lower
items.summary: The forward curve is being dragged down by weak weather forecasts and resilient natural gas production as winter nears, despite some longer-term bullish signals that could send prices higher in some parts of the country.
